Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding early intervention services for children three years old.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to early intervention services for children who arethree years old; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department of social and health servicesand the office of the superintendent of public instruction shalljointly confer and consult with appropriate entities, developrecommendations, and report back to the legislature by October 1, 2007,regarding a policy and process to ensure that children who are eligiblefor special education services under chapter 28A.155 RCW do notexperience a gap in receiving services when transitioning out of infantand toddler early intervention programs upon reaching the age of threeyears.
